en: A black‑and‑white image of a richly ornamented late‑19th‑century mansion in a landscaped garden. The house is built of brick with strong horizontal string courses and corner quoining, a steep mansard/hip roof with dormers, and a prominent corner tower. There is a columned porch, stone balustrades, and a glass conservatory or winter garden projecting into the garden. The grounds feature trimmed bushes, several tall conifer trees, and mature deciduous trees forming a frame around the building. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
